comparisons.name: finder-light-drawing
comparisons.description: The Group and Action pull-down buttons of a Finder toolbar, Aqua: bezels, the place of the glyph boxes and the chevrons. The two glyphs are masked: they are stand-ins drawn for this library, not Apple's artwork.

comparisons.name: split-light-drawing
comparisons.description: The disabled Highlight split button of Preview's toolbar, Aqua: one bezel, the divider, the 19 pt menu part and its dimmed chevron. The highlighter glyph is masked: it is a stand-in drawn for this library.

comparisons.name: open-light
comparisons.description: After a click on the Action button its menu stays open and the button keeps the toolbar button's "on" bezel; the Group button beside it is unchanged, Aqua.

pixels.note: fill of the Action button at mid height: the middle of the toolbar button's on gradient (toolbar-button: fill-on, measured on the selected Finder view segment); that an open pull-down takes it is inferred (spec: toolbar-pop-up, States, open)
fill of the Group button at mid height, at rest: measured on the Finder-Network screenshots at y=148 (#f6f6f6 in Aqua, #646566 in Dark Aqua)

comparisons.name: narrow-light
comparisons.description: A pop-up 76 pt wide with a title too long for it: the title ends with an ellipsis before the chevron, Aqua.

pixels.note: first dot of the ellipsis, on the baseline: the toolbar button's text, black at 65% (toolbar-button: text) over the fill #f5f5f5 of that row; the place is the fallback font's, inferred
third dot of the ellipsis, 3.75 pt after the first: same colour; inferred
above the first dot there is no ink, so it is a dot and not the stem of a letter H: the fill near mid height (measured on the Finder-Network screenshots as #f6f6f6)
between the title and the chevron: the fill at mid height, measured on the Finder-Network screenshots; the title is cut at least 9.5 pt before the chevron
